::: {#perfil}

Master's student at FGV EMAp and researcher in applied mathematics for automation. Holds a BSc in Applied Mathematics from the same institution, funded by the CDMC. Focuses on solving defense-related problems and teaching additive manufacturing techniques for both the Brazilian Marine Corps Officers' Advanced Career Course (C-ApA-CFN) and undergraduate students at FGV EMAp.

## Education

- Master's degree in progress in Applied Mathematics and Data Science. Fundação Getulio Vargas, FGV, Brazil.
- Bachelor's degree in Mathematics. Fundação Getulio Vargas, FGV, Brazil.
- Vocational / Technical Diploma in Mechatronics. Federal Institute of Santa Catarina, IFSC, Brazil.

## Interests

Simulation-Based Inference (SBI), Computer Vision and Machine Learning (ML), Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM), Internet of Things (IoT).
